name: agent-conduct-guidance
description: Consolidated, generally-good agent conduct guidance for Copilot CLI: independent ambient modules with task-time skills where needed. Covers charter-bounded useful autonomy and durable operator pre-clearance without default deployment/data grants; per-machine maintenance standby; consented Windows elevation; scoped multi-agent authority, custody and countermand; headless process-spawn hygiene; coordinator-first delegation and evidence-backed model routing; portable owner-stamped scratch-space hygiene; and secret-pattern masking avoidance. Each module has a declared instruction projection and keeps enforcement with the existing owner. No grant broker, automatic tool approval, runtime or required companion plugin.
